annotations.title: Use a selected Google Drive image as a reference

description: Copy one explicitly selected PNG/JPEG/WebP image (up to 8 MB) from your connected Google Drive account into Berrys reference storage, where generation providers can fetch it. Returns a File nodeId: pass it in referenceNodeIds to use it. Requires a connected Drive account belonging to this Berrys user; another agent’s Drive connection is not inherited. Free; no generation starts. Never accepts credentials or a sharing-page URL.

accountId.description: Connected account ID returned by connected_sources_list.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

fileId.description: Google Drive file ID to import from the selected connected account.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

name: playground_drive_image_import

next.description: Suggested next action; it does not authorize spending.
